language.script_notes: Both scripts appear, varying by entity: house nameplates are mainly in Latin script in the Federation, where Bosniaks and Croats are the majority, and mainly in Cyrillic in Republika Srpska, which also flies a red-blue-white tricolour. The internet domain is .ba.

road_furniture.bollard_shape: Boxy, angular bollards, similar to those of neighbouring countries.
road_furniture.guardrail_type: Boxy, angular guardrails shared with neighbouring countries.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Milepost-style signs with printed road numbers resemble Slovenia's. Yellow arrow signs have black backs, and blue fire hydrants are common, which separates it from the neighbouring country to the west.

architecture.wall_construction: Brick houses like those on the plains to the north are common, alongside Ottoman-era mosques with slender minarets and stone bridges in the old towns.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Mosques with minarets in Bosniak areas and Orthodox churches in Serb areas; unfinished brick family houses; the old Ottoman stone bridge at Mostar.

nature.vegetation: Dense beech and pine forest on the mountains, farmland on the northern plains, and an alpine tundra zone above about 1,500m on peaks such as Bjelašnica.
nature.terrain: Flat plains in the north give way to the mountainous Dinaric Alps in the south; steep karst terrain forces roads to wind along valleys beside green rivers; the country touches the Adriatic Sea only at the short coastline around Neum.
nature.climate_signature: Continental in the north and mountainous in the interior, with a Mediterranean touch only around Neum and the far south.

vehicles.plate_color: White plates whose letters are limited to those written the same in Latin and Cyrillic (A, E, O, J, K, M and T), so the plate reads the same in either script.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: Coverage follows the main valleys and towns; steep mountain areas are thinner.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Cyrillic signs in one entity, boxy thin-B-style guardrails, similar villages and Balkan architecture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Blue fire hydrants, milepost-style signs and plates limited to shared-script letters point here; Serbian bollards show an off-centre red reflector.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Latin-script towns in the Federation, similar red-brick houses on the northern plain and Adriatic coast at Neum
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Blue fire hydrants are common here (sources describe Croatia's as grey or narrow blue, so treat this as a weak tell), Cyrillic appears in one entity, and Croatian signs carry the checkerboard shield.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared mountain roads, similar bollards and milepost-style road signs
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The mix of Latin and Cyrillic, blue fire hydrants and the neighbour-shared boxy guardrails; compare details directly.
